rules.description: Secret-looking variable uses a browser-exposed prefix
rules.fix: Variables with NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_/REACT_APP_/EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefixes are baked into the JavaScript bundle that every visitor downloads. Drop the prefix, read it only on the server, and rotate the value.

rules.description: Supabase admin key referenced in client-side code
rules.fix: Admin keys must never reach the browser. Move this call into a server route/action (route.ts, a Server Action, or an Edge Function) and use the anon/publishable key in client code.

rules.description: Debug mode enabled in a production config file
rules.fix: Debug output can leak stack traces, env values and internal paths. Disable it for production.

rules.description: Environment file is committed to git
rules.fix: Run `git rm --cached {file}`, add it to .gitignore, and rotate every value in it — they are in your git history now (see --history).
Add `.env*` and `!.env.example` to .gitignore so the next `git add .` can't commit it.
Every value in this file is public to anyone with the repo. Rotate them all, then purge the file from history with git filter-repo or BFG.
